question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice. Was your bicycle stolen by him?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "Was your bicycle stolen by him?"
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "he" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "was stolen" to "did steal" (simple past active).
 
• Ensure the object "your bicycle" follows the verb for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Did he steal your bicycle?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Was he stealing your bicycle?" – This changes the tense and form of the original sentence.
 
• **Option 2: **"Has he stolen your bicycle?" – This changes the tense of the original sentence.
 
• **Option 3: **"Had he stolen your bicycle?" – This changes the tense of the original sentence.
